test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Susan had recently run on to / Catherine at the supermarket, they / were seeing each other after many years.

options.text: Susan had recently run on to
were seeing each other after many years.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Susan had recently run on to**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the error lies in the usage of the phrase "run on."**
 
• The phrase "run on" means to continue for a long time, especially past an expected finishing time.
 
 
• Example: These meetings always run on for hours.
 
 
 
• Thus, it does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **The correct phrase is "run into" instead of "run on to".**
 
 
• **"Run into" means to meet somebody by chance.**
 
 
• Example: I ran into my school classmate today.
 
 
 
 
 
• The phrase "run into" matches the context of the sentence as Susan met Catherine by chance at the supermarket.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
